content.concept_description: A finger navigates a tight grid of interlocking toy brick blocks, sliding them to align with exit arrows and clear the board.
content.why_it_works: The tactile plastic brick aesthetic and clean sliding mechanics create a satisfying spatial puzzle that draws viewers in to see the board cleared.

visuals.notable_objects: Toy brick puzzle pieces, exit arrow indicators

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Sliding different colored brick shapes into empty spaces on a grid to maneuver them out of exit arrows on the side.

chapterization.chapter_description: A hand cursor tests sliding blocks on a packed board and clears the first brick.
Sequential moves rearrange smaller bricks to unlock pathways toward the exits.
Intricate maneuvers shift blocks around the massive yellow brick to prepare its escape.
Block Buster logo and Play Now call to action display on screen.
